program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((legend (take (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g)) 4))
         (pivot (first (find-color g 5)))
         (cells (filter (lambda (cell)
                          (and (> (first cell) 0)
                               (not (member (third cell) (list 0 5)))))
                        (grid-cells g))))
    (define base
      (set-cell
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
                  ([v (in-list legend)] [c (in-naturals)])
          (set-cell out 0 c v))
        (first pivot) (second pivot) 5))
    (define (rot-cell cell turn)
      (let* ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell))
             (dr (- r (first pivot))) (dc (- c (second pivot)))
             (v (list-ref legend turn)))
        (cond [(= turn 0) (list (+ (first pivot) dr) (+ (second pivot) dc) v)]
              [(= turn 1) (list (+ (first pivot) dc) (- (second pivot) dr) v)]
              [(= turn 2) (list (- (first pivot) dr) (- (second pivot) dc) v)]
              [else (list (- (first pivot) dc) (+ (second pivot) dr) v)])))
    (for*/fold ([out base])
               ([turn (in-list (list 0 1 2 3))]
                [cell (in-list cells)])
      (let ((p (rot-cell cell turn)))
        (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g))
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (third p))
            out)))))
